overview.description: The BNY Mellon International Equity ETF (BKIE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of large- and mid-cap companies from developed markets, excluding the US. BKIE was launched on Apr 24, 2020 and is issued by BNY Mellon.
